verdict.rationale: Paperspace's own API is versioned: the production OpenAPI 3.0.3 document is served at /v1/openapi.json with version "1" and servers at https://api.paperspace.com/v1, and the unversioned path returns 404. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning/lifecycle guarantees (notice periods, sunset headers, changelog), independent corroboration of API stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json (info title "Paperspace OpenAPI", version "1", 61 paths; servers https://api.paperspace.com/v1).
The path without /v1 answers 404; the versioned path is the artifact.
